trust_decision.summary: Under a security policy, {fetch} decides whether a remote URI is allowed by reducing it to scheme://host and matching trusted_uri (Security::isTrustedUri); the outbound request must then reach only that validated host.

landing_point.why: The summary names {fetch} and redirects; the only redirect-following primitive in Fetch is the file_get_contents() fallback for non-http protocols (the http:// branch is a hand-rolled fsockopen client that does not follow redirects).

fix_sites.entry_point: template tag {fetch file=...} rendered via Smarty::fetch()/display() with enableSecurity()
fix_sites.module_kind: template function handler (v5, the pinned tree)

fix_sites.entry_point: same {fetch} tag on the Smarty v4 branch (libs/plugins/function.fetch.php); this file does not exist in the pinned v5 tree
fix_sites.module_kind: v4 port on another branch, not applicable to this tree

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: In the pinned v5 tree the SSRF fix touches only src/FunctionHandler/Fetch.php:192; the second commit is a v4 backport (fix.diff:164-193) whose other hunks (html_image XSS fix.diff:194-220, html_select_date fix.diff:221-248, symlink _checkDir fix.diff:249-289) belong to other advisories.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: {html_image} only calls getimagesize() to read width/height, it is skipped when both are given, and the advisory names only {fetch}; the {fetch} proxy_host route is an explicitly chosen proxy, not a redirect.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Without a security policy, remote fetches must keep default redirect behaviour (the fix's own test asserts no context options are passed); local file and plain http:// fsockopen fetches must keep working under security.

O6_input_shapes: non-http remote scheme reached through file_get_contents (https://, ftp://, other registered stream wrappers), gated by $protocol && security_policy (fix.diff:21)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: {html_image file="https://trusted/..."} without width/height: isTrustedUri validates only the initial URL, then getimagesize() fetches it through the http wrapper, which follows redirects by default (no context)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Advisory names only {fetch}; getimagesize is 'just' a dimension probe and the call is skipped when width/height are supplied; yet docs/api/security.md:13-16 state trusted_uri governs both {fetch} and {html_image}.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: sibling file in the same package (src/FunctionHandler/)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: {fetch file="http://trusted/" proxy_host=X proxy_port=N}: trusted_uri checks the file URL, but the socket is opened to the template-supplied proxy_host:proxy_port, an arbitrary host
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Proxy support is a deliberate feature and not a redirect; the advisory text is about redirect following only.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, other branch (http fsockopen client, src/FunctionHandler/Fetch.php:141-145)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the getimagesize() remote probe already lacks a no-redirect context; a planted wrapper helper (e.g. a remote image-size reader) would be the same mechanism
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the FIXME at src/FunctionHandler/HtmlImage.php:114 invites a custom remote header reader, which a maintainer could write with file_get_contents/fopen and default context

O8b_injection_room.sibling: adding Location-following to the hand-rolled http client (docs say redirects are unsupported, docs/designers/language-custom-functions/language-function-fetch.md:15-18)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a maintainer closing the documented 'no redirects' limitation would naturally follow Location headers without re-running isTrustedUri

O9_family: CWE-918 SSRF: allow-list check on initial URL bypassed by redirect following / connection to a host other than the validated one

O10_build.project_tests: tests/UnitTests/TemplateSource/TagTests/PluginFunction/PluginFunctionFetchTest.php (local-file security tests only at the pinned commit); the fix's tests use a custom stream wrapper to capture context options offline (fix.diff:93-137)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Pass a follow_location=0 stream context to the file_get_contents() call in Fetch.php and stop, leaving {html_image}'s getimagesize() and the proxy_host socket untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: HtmlImage strips file:// from $params['file'] (src/FunctionHandler/HtmlImage.php:93-95) but $_image_path is computed earlier from the unstripped $file (src/FunctionHandler/HtmlImage.php:87-91) and is what isTrustedResourceDir checks: possible local-path check differential (CWE-22, other advisory).
Stream resources ({include file="https://..."}) are gated only by isTrustedStream with no host allow-list (src/Resource/BasePlugin.php:85-92); a different protection.
Fix commit a1ccdb05 also carries unrelated v4 XSS (html_image, html_select_date) and symlink CWE-22 backports.
